title.zh: 美国数据中心到2028年或面临32GW电力缺口，ASIC、存储和光模块供应链承压
title.en: 美国数据中心到2028年或面临32GW电力缺口，ASIC、存储和光模块供应链承压

current_state.zh: Morgan Stanley warns the US faces a ~32GW (34%) data-center power shortfall from 2026-2028, shifting the bottleneck from chips to electricity and threatening ASIC, storage, optical module and power-management supply chains, with Oracle's 1.3GW Wisconsin project possibly delayed to 2028-2029.
current_state.en: Morgan Stanley warns the US faces a ~32GW (34%) data-center power shortfall from 2026-2028, shifting the bottleneck from chips to electricity and threatening ASIC, storage, optical module and power-management supply chains, with Oracle's 1.3GW Wisconsin project possibly delayed to 2028-2029.
